summary: Possible typosquat of MetaMask SDK — name misspelling under unofficial scope
details: Package published as `@wagni_bot/metemask-sdk` under an unaffiliated user scope. The name `metemask-sdk` is a 1-character misspelling of `metamask-sdk`, the official MetaMask JavaScript SDK, and the scope `@wagni_bot` is not associated with MetaMask/ConsenSys. No installer-harm payload was observed in the scanned files (no exfiltration, no lifecycle-hook fetch-and-execute, no credential access, no silent-relay), so a confirmed-attack classification is not supported by the current evidence — however the name-similarity to a widely-used wallet SDK is a subjective confusion signal that warrants human review before allowing it into a dependency tree.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
